dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: I've been raising 3 Slimes. They like to be lifted up in the air and especially enjoy jumping through hoops.

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: They go faster when you use Acting Grand Master Jean's <color=#00E1FFFF>Gale Blade</color> though.\nHow about making the Slimes jump through 10 hoops before time runs out! It'll make them happy! Wanna try?

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: Thank you! Now, please welcome <color=#00E1FFFF>Acting Grand Master Jean</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: Use the <color=#00E1FFFF>Gale Blade</color> to make the Slimes jump faster! Time is running out!

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: That's too bad... You couldn't complete the challenge on time.

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: Congrats on completing the challenge! Thank you, my Slimes had a lot of fun!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Master Jean is prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: It's challenge time! Make the Slimes jump through 10 hoops before time limit! Ready... Go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She doesn't seem to be here...

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: Ah? She isn't here? Too bad, we can only wait for the next time she stops by.
